description: Use when someone is choosing a dog breed or asks which breeds are healthy, e.g. 'healthiest small dog breeds' or 'welche Rasse passt zu mir'. Searches HonestDog's breed catalogue by name (German or English, umlauts optional), size class, or S–E breeding-health grade, most popular first. Returns breed slugs for the other tools, a breed photo, and the honestdog.de breed page URL. / Durchsucht den HonestDog-Rassenkatalog nach Name, Größe oder S–E-Gesundheitsnote.

health_grade.description: HonestDog S–E health grade (S = healthiest breeding basis)

query.description: Breed name or part of it, in German or English, umlauts optional — e.g. 'pudel', 'german shepherd', 'schaeferhund'

size.description: Size class filter. Breeds are recorded as small/medium/large (toy and giant currently match nothing)

name: search_breeds
title: Search dog breeds
